goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Run Barnes-Hut as a focused Step-1 replacement productized-runner A/B before any all-app run.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use the dual comparison: runner versus existing fused partner for parity, and runner versus historical OptiX frontier only as a no-go reference.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish move would be to count only the large speedup versus the known slow OptiX frontier route and ignore whether the runner preserves the existing fused partner speed.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: A full all-app run is possible, but it would mix Set A and Set B before this trunk candidate has a focused, productized-path result.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. This follows the redirect: trunk first, all-app later.
